functions.name: AnyDecorPlacedInRoom
documentation: Returns true if any decor objects are placed in a given room

functions.name: CancelActiveEditing
documentation: Cancels all in-progress editing of the selected target, which will reset any unsaved changes and deselect the active target

functions.name: CommitDecorMovement
documentation: Attempt to save the changes made to the currently selected decor instance

functions.name: GetAllMaxPlacementBudgets
documentation: Returns the interior and exterior max decor placement budgets for the current owned house interior or plot; Can be increased via house level

returns.name: interiorMaxBudgets
documentation: Map of budget type to max budget amount; Will be nil if not in an owned House or Plot

returns.name: exteriorMaxBudgets
documentation: Map of budget type to max budget amount; Will be nil if not in an owned House or Plot

functions.name: GetAllSpentPlacementBudgets
documentation: Returns how much of the interior and exterior placement budgets for the current owned house interior or plot's decor budget have been spent

returns.name: interiorSpentBudgets
documentation: Map of budget type to spent budget amount; Will be nil if not in an owned House or Plot

returns.name: exteriorSpentBudgets
documentation: Map of budget type to spent budget amount; Will be nil if not in an owned House or Plot

functions.name: GetDecorAssignedPetName

functions.name: GetDecorInstanceInfoForGUID

functions.name: GetHoveredDecorInfo

returns.name: maxBudget
documentation: Will be nil if not in an owned House or Plot

functions.name: GetMaxPlacementBudget

returns.name: maxBudget
documentation: Will be nil if not in an owned House or Plot

functions.name: GetNumDecorPlaced
documentation: Returns the number of individual decor objects placed in the current house or plot; This is NOT the value used in placement budget calculations, see GetSpentPlacementBudget for that

functions.name: GetSelectedDecorInfo
documentation: Returns info for the placed decor instance that's currently selected, if there is one

functions.name: GetSpentPetPlacementBudget
documentation: Returns how much of the current owned house interior or plot's pet decor placement budget has been spent

returns.name: totalCost
documentation: Will be nil if not in an owned House or Plot

functions.name: GetSpentPlacementBudget
documentation: Returns how much of the current owned house interior or plot's decor placement budget has been spent; Different kinds of decor take up different budget amounts, so this value isn't an individual decor count, see GetNumDecorPlaced for that

returns.name: totalCost
documentation: Will be nil if not in an owned House or Plot

functions.name: HasMaxPlacementBudget
documentation: Returns whether there's a max decor placement budget available and active for the current player, in the current house interior or plot
